$comment: The successful GraphQL response is wrapped under data.createPost and contains the Post directly under post. MutationError is an alternative union branch, so a success does not also carry an empty message field.

post.text: A useful update should not be shortened to accommodate generated source formatting.

response.$errorsComment: No top-level errors key on success. System failures use GraphQL's errors array; user-fixable mutation failures instead select the MutationError.message branch under data.createPost.
